items.title: Epoch AI releases Chess Puzzles v2 benchmark update
items.summary_en: A search-engine summary says Epoch released Chess Puzzles v2 on 14 October 2026. The benchmark page could not be opened, so contents and results are unconfirmed.
items.notes: Date and v2 claim from a web-search digest; epoch.ai unreachable (DNS). Human should check before use.

items.title: Data insight: open-weight models lag closed models on cyber capabilities by roughly 6-7 months
items.summary_en: According to a search digest, an Epoch data insight dated 16 October 2026 estimates that open-weight models trail closed models on cyber capabilities by about six to seven months. It also says Z.ai's GLM-5.3 is the top open-weight model on Epoch's Cyber ECI.
items.notes: Index page, not the article URL. Figures from a search digest, unchecked; methodology caveats unknown.

items.title: AI data centers database: Colossus 2 listed as the largest tracked site (about 946 MW)
items.summary_en: According to a search digest of Epoch's data hub, as of October 2026 Colossus 2 is the largest tracked AI data center at about 946 MW of current IT power. Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle follows at about 910 MW. The database reportedly covers about 44% of global deployed AI compute, with a wide 90% confidence interval of 30% to 79%.
items.source_name: Epoch AI Data on AI Data Centers
items.notes: Living dataset; date is the collection date, not a release date. Unverified.
